about_the_game:
All endgame. No filler.

Mutagenic is a hack-and-slash ARPG built from the ground up around what keeps you playing, not what keeps you waiting. There's no 40-hour campaign standing between you and the build you want to make.

Shape your character from the ground up with a massive passive tree offering thousands of potential builds. Combine and refine your abilities through a vast library of active skills, supports, and unique variations each capable of transforming how you fight. From elemental juggernauts to agile casters, every build is a unique expression of your imagination.

Battle through dynamic encounters that test both your reflexes and your ingenuity. Discover rare loot to unlock new forms of power, craft devastating gear, and push your creation beyond its limits.

Then, climb the global leaderboards to prove your mastery. The most efficient builds, the boldest experiments, and the fastest clears all earn their place among the Mutagenic elite.

BUILD CRAFTING

Choose from 6 classes and over 30 specializations, each with their own passive tree. Slot dozens of skill gems across 5 damage types:  Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, and Darkness. Reshape how they work with nearly countless support gems. Every combination changes how your build plays.

The passive tree is massive, with nearly 5000 passives, and hybrid classes like the Battlemage and Spellthief reward creative pathing across attribute boundaries. There's no single best build, just the one you haven't found yet.

DIFFICULTY

The Rift Device is where endgame progression lives. Socket Rift Shards to layer modifiers onto your runs where every beneficial mod comes paired with real danger. More item rarity? Monsters hit harder. Bigger packs? They resist your damage. Stack shards strategically to maximize your rewards while walking the line between profit and a wipe.

How far you push is up to you.

ITEMIZATION

Items roll with tiered affixes: prefixes, suffixes, and implicits. Each one scales with a full quality system that improves their power. Craft mods onto your gear, hunt chase-tier uniques for an entire layer of build customization beyond your equipment. Use Void Runes to gamble with your gear to make one-of-a-kind powerhouses.

... and so much more.

See you on the leaderboards!

~zediven
